args.purpose: Calculate 2018 Jan-Aug revenue and SP share
args.sql:
with rev as (
  select 
    o.order_id,
    c.customer_state,
    i.price
  from orders o
  join order_items i on o.order_id = i.order_id
  join customers c on o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  where o.order_status not in ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    and o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
    and o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-09-01'
)
select 
  sum(price) as total_revenue,
  sum(case when customer_state = 'SP' then price else 0 end) as sp_revenue,
  sum(case when customer_state = 'SP' then price else 0 end) * 100.0 / sum(price) as sp_share
from rev
